governance.attested_by: pjm-97 measured-interfaces 2026-07-10: pjm-94 recipe + pjm_seam_measured_ladder + pjm_measured_interface_limits + pjm_reserve_pergen + measured_ramp_capability; OWNER-DIRECTED keeper promotion 2026-07-10 (rule 1: most structurally faithful -- both transmission channels measured, zero fitted scalars -- superseding the residual-seeded static estimates in the pjm-94 lineage)
governance.note: Two measured-physical transmission mechanisms enter vs pjm-94: (1) the external seam bands price at the measured per-year Q-Q ladders (PJM_SEAM_LADDER_BY_YEAR, frozen derive script); (2) the seven mapped internal links' forward TTC follows the measured HOURLY Data Miner 2 transfer limits (transfer-interface-limits clean datatype; min(pre,post); reverse direction keeps the static rating; PJM_INTERFACE_LINK_MAP documents the rule-14 boundary reconciliations, incl. AP-South applied only to its seeded link and Cleveland deliberately unmapped). Plus the pjm-81 owner-recommended structure: per-gen reserve co-opt (nested RTO+MAD measured families) and measured ramp capability (deliverable pool 48.2 -> 37.8 GW). No mechanism in this delta carries a fitted scalar, so the rule-22 LOO-before-promotion clause (which cross-validates TUNED mechanism changes) is vacuous for this flip.
governance.residuals_note: Honest fit record vs pjm-94: C1 15/16 free 11/12 (was 14/16 free 10/12; the 2023 CC_REGULAR cell clears via the seam ladder); C2 PASS->CAVEAT (+3.0% 2025 gas, commercial band); C3a -14.9->-15.6% (2025 FAIL); C3b 1-of-3 -> 3-of-3 FAIL (0.232/0.219/0.249; enters with the seam ladder, interface limits neutral on top); C3c unchanged 0/6, 0/18, 0/59 h >$200. The measured caps BIND (AEP->Dominion ~94% of hours at its hourly limit); ComEd corridor over-run cut (CT 2024 +73->+35%, 2025 +111->+85%); eastern under-run persists (Dominion CC 2023 -81%, EMAAC CT -83%, SWMAAC CC 2025 -93%) and CT per-plant capture falls (2023 median r 0.301->0.246). OPEN root cause handed to G-20: with both transmission channels measured, Dominion is a through-corridor (imports at cap, re-exports at cap into SWMAAC 5193-6703 h/yr), no cut binds around the MAD zones, 2025 net export overshoots 27.1 vs 18.0 TWh -- the eastern CC/CT commitment posture (pjm-81 attribution) and the Dominion seam-inflow structure, an offer/commitment problem, not transmission. Per rule 14 the measured inputs stay; the worse CT capture under truer physics is the discovered-bug signal for that layer.
